column1: # cron components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Rows are "KIND:FILE:LINE<TAB>command<TAB>display"; systemd timers are the systemd module's timers mode.
mode    all      -          your crontab and the system's, next run first                           default
mode    user     -          your crontab (commented-out entries as disabled)                        -
mode    scripts  -          the run-parts directories (cron.daily ...) and when their job runs next  -
sort    next     -          all, user, system: next run first                                      default
sort    file     -          all, user, system: in file order                                       -
action  edit     ctrl-e     your crontab: crontab -e; system files and scripts: sudoedit at the line  foreground,reload
action  disable  alt-d      your crontab: comment the entry out, or back in                        notify,reload
action  run      alt-enter  your crontab: run the command now, in your home through /bin/sh (system entries are refused)  foreground
action  copy     ctrl-y     copy the commands                                                      silent,builtin
